notes: MLXUI-authored (RSI/DelegateModelPackBacklog.md MP6-W) -- catflow-mlx has no manifest for this model, so this was written in the shape of qwen3-asr-1.7b-8bit.json. It has no checksum field, as the other MLXUI-authored manifests have none: there is no catflow source manifest to inherit one from and the field is documentary. settings is empty on purpose: the engine takes no language (English only, per the model card) and returns text only, and the model has no voice list (its text-to-speech takes free text added to the instruction, which a flow row has no setting for), so no lang, timestamps or voice setting is offered; adding one would be a SPEC-Q, not a manifest edit. tasks lists the two flow tasks the model genuinely serves (Transcribe = its speech-to-text mode, Speak = its text-to-speech mode); its voice conversation mode is not a flow task. resources.disk_gb is browser.json's downloadSizeGB (1.73) and resources.ram_gb is its ramGB 5.0, MEASURED: harness PEAK 4733 MiB = 4.96 GB (worst-case session, 7 x ~59 s voice turns, turn 6; LFMAudioFootprintTests; build add-lfm25-audio, 2026-10-28; journal 2026-621); in-app peak 2.73 GB. License: the model card's lfm1.0, shown as LFM Open License v1.0; read it before commercial use. Original model by Liquid AI (LiquidAI/LFM2.5-Audio-1.5B).
